welcome_body: A few questions about how you feel. Two tasks about the choices you make.
local_notice: Results stay in this browser. Download them when you finish.
required: Complete all session details to begin.
instructions_label: Read the instructions before you begin.
video_failed: The video could not play. Check the study media, then try again.
recovery_body: Download its completed responses before starting another session.
interrupted_body: Completed responses have been retained. Download them below.
storage_error: The browser could not save your response. Stop here and download the retained results. Check browser storage before starting another session.
storage_unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Allow storage for this page, then reload to start safely.
setup_error: The experiment could not load. Serve the repository locally and check the study files, then reload.
media_error: A required study image or sound could not load. Check the files, then try again.
hidden_body: The window lost focus. Return here to continue. This interruption will be recorded with the session.
download_hint: CSV contains the original study columns. The journal can be converted to Excel with the existing recovery tool.
video_hint: When you are ready, play the video. The next questions appear when it ends.
download_success: Download prepared. Keep the file before clearing browser data.
fullscreen_error: Full screen could not open. Continue in this window or try again.
memory_only: Responses are available in memory. Download them before leaving this page.
